| `EventManagement` (`event-management.ts`)                                                                                | The organizer's access to the events this browser manages: `claim(eventId, token)` hands a management link's token to `ManagementTokens` (`apps/web/src/app/core/auth`), which keeps it per event until the browser signs out (one cut short is ignored), `claims` counts the links this page took (a page showing an event reads it again when it grows), `read(eventId)` answers a `Management`, `confirm(eventId, optionId)` a `ConfirmAnswer`, `retry(eventId, type)` (a failed email tried once more) a `RetryAnswer`, `changeDeadline(eventId, deadline)` (reopening voting if it had closed) and `closeVoting(eventId)` answer a `Management` (a `409`, confirmed meanwhile, the event read again; a malformed ID on closing, `refused`; a day the API no longer allows, as after midnight, rejects as a failure), `replaceOptions(eventId, options, replacing)` (`PUT /api/events/{id}/options`, with the IDs of the options the editor started from) answers an `OptionsSave`, `cancel(eventId)` (`DELETE /api/events/{id}` with the token) answers `{ kind: 'cancelled', title }`, also on a `410` (cancelled already), and `refused` on `401` or `403`; they reject only when the request did not get through (network, server, rate limit). A confirmation refused because the event changed meanwhile (`409`, `400`) answers the event read again, as does a retry of an email that was no longer failed. |
| `Management` (`event-management.ts`)                                                                                     | What the page can show: `managed` with the event, `signIn` (no management link and no live session: the page sends the organizer to sign in), `refused`, or `cancelled` with the kept title.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `FinalDateNotice` (`final-date.ts`)                                                                                      | What `FinalDate`'s amber box tells: `optionsChanged`, a date was not confirmed because the options were replaced since the page read them; `votedMeanwhile` or `optionsOutdated`, the options the editor saved were not.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `OptionsLock`, `optionsLock(event)` (`event-management.ts`)                                                              | Why an event's options can no longer change: `voted` (someone voted, told first), `closed` (voting over: closed or a date confirmed); null while they can.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `OptionsNotSaved`, `backToManagement(router, eventId, notSaved = null)`, `notSavedOnArrival()` (`back-to-management.ts`) | `OptionsNotSaved` is `votedMeanwhile` or `optionsOutdated`. `backToManagement` opens the event's management page in the editor's place (`replaceUrl`), carrying why the options were not saved in the navigation's state; `notSavedOnArrival`, called while the management page is built, gives that reason only when a navigation made inside the app opened it, not a reload nor a move through the history (they bring the browser's saved state back), and null otherwise.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `ConfirmAnswer` (`event-management.ts`)                                                                                  | What `confirm` answers: a `Management`, or `optionsChanged` with the event read again when the options were replaced since the page read them (`409 OPTIONS_CHANGED`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `RetryAnswer` (`event-management.ts`)                                                                                    | What `retry` answers: `retried` with the email's new state, or else a `Management` (the event read again after a `409` or `400`, refused, cancelled).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `OptionsSave` (`event-management.ts`)                                                                                    | What `replaceOptions` answers: `saved`; `votedMeanwhile` (`409 VOTES_EXIST`) or `optionsOutdated` (`409 OPTIONS_CHANGED`: replaced from another tab or device since the editor opened); or `refused`, the event confirmed or closed (`409`), cancelled (`410`) or no longer managed by this browser (`401`, `403`), which its management page shows. Options the API turns down (`400`) reject, as a request that did not get through.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `openManagementLink` (`management-link.ts`), guard of `/manage/:eventId`                                                 | Opens the management link: hands its token to `EventManagement` and opens the page without it in the address bar or the history; also when the link is pasted over its event's page (only the fragment changes), which then reads the event again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### `apps/web/src/app/features/my-events`

**Summary:** "Mis eventos", the signed-in account's events.

**Purpose:** The private page an account lands on after signing in: one card with a row per event, newest first, each opening its management page, where the session grants access without the management link. Each row shows the title and the state line of the management page ("Votación abierta hasta el…", the lock and "Votación cerrada el…"), or the lock and "Fecha confirmada". A long list scrolls inside the card, never taller than the screen between its title and the "+", and fades at its foot while rows wait below. The card ends with a round "+" (`circle-link`, named "Crear un evento") to the home page, under the list or, with no events, under "Aún no has creado ningún evento.". The card, its heading, the rows with their title and state line, and the sentence without events are the stylesheet partial `_list-card.scss` (`apps/web/src/styles`), shared with "Apps conectadas" (`apps/web/src/app/features/connected-apps`).

**Components:**

| Component                                                   | Inputs → outputs | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`MyEventsPage`** (`my-events-page.*`), route `/my-events` | none             | Reads `GET /api/me/events` (`apiResource`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`) and shows loading, the error with "Reintentar", the empty card or the list. Measures the list when it appears, on its scroll and on a window resize to fade its foot while rows wait below (a fraction of a pixel left counts as none); the state line is marked `data-strong-text`, so its bold date reads darker than the rest. When the API answers `401` (the session ended since the page opened) it shows loading, not the error, and `signInAgainOnceEnded` (`apps/web/src/app/core/auth`) has `Session` ask the API again, so the header shows "Entrar", and then opens the sign-in page, which comes back here, unless the user has left the page meanwhile. |

**Depends on:** `apps/web/src/styles`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`, `apps/web/src/app/core/auth`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, `apps/web/src/app/features/vote`, `packages/contracts/src/management`.

**Used by:** `apps/web/src/app`.

### `apps/web/src/app/features/privacy`

**Summary:** "Privacidad y condiciones", what qando keeps and its terms of use.

**Purpose:** The page anyone can open, signed in or not, that says in plain words what qando keeps, what for, for how long, who else handles the data, what an AI assistant connected to an account can do and who handles what it reads ("Asistentes de IA"), which cookies it uses and how to see or delete one's data, followed by short terms of use. All its copy lives in the catalogue (`privacy` in `apps/web/src/i18n/es.json`).

### `apps/web/src/app/features/results`

**Summary:** The results page.

**Purpose:** The page opened with the results link: what the votes amount to as they stand now, provisional while voting is open and final after, with the buttons to share the link. Labels of dates are made here, in the active language, from the calendar values the API answers.

**Components:**

| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

A link of no results (`404`, `400` malformed, `403` the participation link) shows `NotFoundCard`; a cancelled event (`410`) the cancelled `VoteEnded` (`apps/web/src/app/features/vote`); only a failed request offers to try again. |
| **`ResultsChart`** (`results-chart.*`)                            | `winners`, `alternatives`, `voters`    | A legend of the three answers, then one bar per winner and, under their own heading, one per alternative: each answer as wide as its share of the voters (an answer nobody gave is left out); options with names offer their `NameList` under the bar.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **`NameList`** (`name-list.*`)                                    | `names`, `look` (`winner` or `option`) | Who answered an option, behind a "Lista de asistentes" toggle that starts closed: the preferred in bold, then the available, then, struck through, who cannot come; a screen reader hears the answer after each marked name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

The shapes are in the catalogue (`results.label.*`, connecting words between `<m>` marks). |
| `LabelPart` (`option-labels.ts`)    | A piece of a long label: its `text` and whether it is `minor`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### `apps/web/src/app/features/sign-in`

**Summary:** The sign-in page.

**Purpose:** The page where an organizer signs in with a code sent to their email, without a password: first the email, then the code, in one card. Once signed in it gives its place to the page that asked for it, "Mis eventos" without one. Opened by an application's request to connect (the authorization server sends a browser without a session here, the request signed in the address's query), it sends the request with the code and, once signed in, leaves for the address the API answers, where the request goes on. The email step's look is the stylesheet partial `_sign-in-step.scss` (`apps/web/src/styles`), which the code step (`CodeStep`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`) shares.

**Components:**

| Component                                             | Inputs → outputs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`SignInPage`** (`sign-in-page.*`), route `/sign-in` | `returnTo` (from the address's query)                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Asks for the email in a Signal Form, with the focus on its field; an email that is not an address by the contract (`signInCodeBodySchema`, `packages/contracts/src/auth`, the form's validator) is said so without sending, once the form is sent and until the email changes. Otherwise sends it a code (`POST /api/auth/sign-in-code`) and hands over to `SignInCode`, giving it the request to connect an application that opened the page, if one did (`connectionRequestOf`, `apps/web/src/app/core/auth`, read from the route's query when the page is created); a code not sent, or too many codes with the time to wait, shows under the button (`FailureNotice`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`), which is off while sending or waiting. "Cambiar email" comes back to the email, kept as typed. Once signed in, opens `returnTarget(returnTo)` (`apps/web/src/app/core/auth`) in place of itself in the browser's history; when `SignInCode` gives the address the API answered for a request to connect (`continueTo`), leaves for that address instead, through `WholeNavigation.replaceWith` (`apps/web/src/app/core/auth`), as the app's router does not serve it. |
| **`SignInCode`** (`sign-in-code.*`)                   | `email`, `resendAfterSeconds`, `purpose` (`sign-in` by default, or `create` inside the wizard's last step), `name` (optional: the name a new account takes), `connectionRequest` (optional: the request to connect an application that opened the sign-in page) → `signedIn` (with the address the API says the browser opens next, when the sign-in carried a request to connect), `changeEmail`, `codeSent` (the seconds until another code may be asked) | The step that signs in with the code emailed to `email`, inside the page's card: the code step (`CodeStep`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, which keeps the 6 digits, shows each refusal and counts the wait for a new code down) whose complete code sends `POST /api/auth/sign-in` (with `name` and `connectionRequest`, if given), then has `Session` (`apps/web/src/app/core/auth`) ask the API for the account again (`refresh`) and emits `signedIn`, so the page told next finds the account already known, with the `continueTo` the API answered (none unless the sign-in carried a request to connect); its new code is `POST /api/auth/sign-in-code`, emitting `codeSent`. Under the step, "¿Email mal escrito? Cambiar email" emits `changeEmail`, not while a code is checked. On the sign-in page its heading is the page's `h1`; inside the wizard (`purpose` "create") it is an `h2` and the hint under the field says that the last digit creates the event. |

**Depends on:** `apps/web/src/styles`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`, `apps/web/src/app/core/auth`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, `packages/contracts`.

**Used by:** `apps/web/src/app` (routes), `apps/web/src/app/features/create` (`SignInCode`).

### `apps/web/src/app/features/vote`

**Summary:** The voting page.

**Purpose:** The page a participant opens with the participation link, from the welcome card to the thank-you screen, including editing an earlier vote from the same browser or from the private link. Each browser guards its votes with its own vote-edit tokens. The boxes of times of a column of step 3 are drawn by the Sass mixin `rules` of `_time-blocks.scss` (their heights are the units `foldOf` counts), which the wizard's summary (`apps/web/src/app/features/create`) draws its boxes with too.

**Components:**

| Component                                              | Inputs → outputs                                                                           | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`VotePage`** (`vote-page.*`), route `/vote/:eventId` | `eventId`                                                                                  | Reads the event and the vote this browser holds, walks the voter through the steps as a stack of cards, keeps the name and the answers while the voter goes back and forth, sends the vote and shows the thanks. Once voting has ended (closed, confirmed, cancelled, also when a send is refused for it) shows `VoteEnded` instead, and a link of no event the `NotFoundCard`. A send refused because the options were replaced reads the event again and goes back to the days (or step 1 after the quick vote) with the new options, the name kept, every answer available and the notice of `VoteDays` or `VoteWelcome`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **`VoteWelcome`** (`vote-welcome.*`), step 1           | `event`, `name` (two-way), `sending`, `quickVoteFailure`, `notice` → `choose`, `quickVote` | Presents the event, asks for the name on named events (a Signal Form over `name` with `isValidVoterName`; the field stops at `VOTER_NAME_MAX_LENGTH` with `CharacterLimit`), says when this browser already voted, the private link holds no vote, or the options changed (an alert), and offers the two ways to vote: choose the dates, or the quick vote; under them, why the quick vote failed (`FailureNotice`), both held while a rate limit lasts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **`VoteDays`** (`vote-days.*`), step 2                 | `options`, `answers` (two-way), `optionsChanged` → `back`, `done`, `toTimes`               | Over the instructions, when `optionsChanged`, the amber alert "Las opciones han cambiado: vuelve a marcar tus preferencias.". The proposed days month by month (the calendar's words from `calendarWords`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, its card and grid from the `calendar` mixins, `apps/web/src/styles`); a tap toggles available ↔ unavailable, a long press or double-click marks the preferred one. In an event with times a day stands for all its times and goes on to step 3, and the mouse over a day (or a long press) previews its times. Options that share days are only outlined and answered by one chip each, with the same gestures. From 650 px the chips are below the calendar: the mouse or the keyboard focus on a chip paints its days, and an outlined day lifts its chips under the mouse. Below 650 px a tap on an outlined day opens its overlap in a `Dialog`: the overlap's days as a strip (`stripOf`) and its chips, the last one answered painted in the strip. |
| **`VoteTimes`** (`vote-times.*`), step 3               | `options`, `answers` (two-way), `timeZone` → `back`, `done`                                | The times of each day still possible, page by page (four columns from 650 px, three below, each narrower when the card leaves less room, two of their usual width under 320 px; back on the first page when that changes), answered the same way as the days; names the event's time zone when the browser's is another; each column under its header (`ColumnHeader`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`); a column over 10 units scrolls under ︿ ﹀ (`ScrollFold`), and on a phone any column too tall for the step's buttons to stay on screen (`screenRoom`); on a phone a tap on such a column's header or arrows opens its whole day in a modal (`Dialog`), answered the same way.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **`VoteConfirm`** (`vote-confirm.*`)                   | `answers`, `deadline`, `sending`, `failure` → `back`, `send`                               | The confirmation bubble over the last step: what the answers amount to, and the button that sends them; a failed send is told inside it (`FailureNotice`), the button held while a rate limit lasts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **`VoteThanks`** (`vote-thanks.*`)                     | `organizerName`, `deadline`, `editLink`, `updated`                                         | The thank-you screen, with the private link to edit the vote from another browser, to open or copy (`LinkCopier`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, which says "Enlace copiado"; refused by the browser, the link stays on the button).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **`VoteEnded`** (`vote-ended.*`)                       | `ended`                                                                                    | The card in place of the steps once voting has ended: closed (white, with a notice about this browser's vote), confirmed (green, the date with weekday, year and time, the event's zone when the browser is in another, and the notice of a vote sent too late) or cancelled (pink, the kept title); projects content (`<ng-content>`) at its end, where the management page adds the message to forward a cancellation; takes the focus to its heading.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| `optionInFull(option, locale, translate)`, `Translate` (`display.ts`)                       | An option as a confirmed date is named: "viernes 10 de julio de 2026, 20:00 a 22:00", with weekday and year of each day and its times; `translate` reads the catalogue's shapes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `zoneCity(timeZone)` (`display.ts`)                                                         | `America/New_York` → "New York", or null when the browser is in that zone (no notice due).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

**Depends on:** `apps/web/src/app/core/api`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, `apps/web/src/styles`, `packages/contracts/src/public-events`, `packages/domain/src`.

**Used by:** `apps/web/src/app`, `apps/web/src/app/features/connected-apps`, `apps/web/src/app/features/create`, `apps/web/src/app/features/manage`, `apps/web/src/app/features/my-events`, `apps/web/src/app/features/results`.

### `apps/web/src/app/shared`

**Summary:** Pieces several pages use.

**Purpose:** Groups the shared UI; a piece moves here once a second page needs it.

**Contents:** `ui/`.

**Depends on:** `apps/web/src/styles`.

**Used by:** `apps/web/src/app`, `apps/web/src/app/features`.

### `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`

**Summary:** Small UI components and directives.

**Purpose:** Generic pieces with no knowledge of events or votes: loading, error and not-found states, the step stack, the toast, the long press, the tooltip, the folded scrolling box, the header of a column of times, the arrows of a step whose content comes in pages, the room a step's boxes have on the screen, the modal dialog, the button that asks before it acts, the copy of a link, the share buttons, the step that asks for a code sent by email, the words of a month calendar and what is drawn over the whole page.

**Components:**

| Component                                                                                                                                 | Inputs → outputs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

Given the error, a rate limit says "Hay demasiadas visitas desde tu red en este momento." and its button counts the seconds down ("Reintentar en 42 s"), disabled until 0 (`requestFailure`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Screen readers hear it once, with the seconds it starts with (a change inside an alert or an alertdialog is read again), the count shown going down hidden from them; the page styles it through its class on the element.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Once the code was right it stays checking (`checking()`, true while a code is checked) as its page goes on. A `400` rejection with a wrong code says the tries left (that code is never used again); an expired code or too many tries turn the field off, the cursor on "Enviar código nuevo"; any other failure shows `FailureNotice` and "Reintentar", not while a limit of tries lasts. A new code (`actions.send()`, whose seconds start the wait again) can be asked once `resendAfterSeconds` have passed, counted down in its button (`secondsUntil`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`). What its page projects goes under the spam line. Its look is the partial `_sign-in-step.scss` (`apps/web/src/styles`), a page's card by default; `look` "dialog" sets the class `dialog`, a smaller heading and every line in the dialog's text size and colour.                                                                                              |

While it slides the page does not move with it. The element needs no click handler of its own. While `repeatWhile` answers false it is a plain button, which fires once when a press ends on it (for an action that must not run before the pointer lifts, such as leaving a step); a hold under way ends there, and its press does not fire again when it lifts. It is asked at each press and before each repeat, not read when the page is drawn: the action itself may change the answer, and a busy page is not drawn again between two repeats.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

| Export                                                                  | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Toaster`, `ToastAction` (`toast.ts`)                                   | Short messages at the bottom of the screen, from any page, one at a time. `show(message)`: a message for two seconds ("Enlace copiado"). `offer(message, action)`: a message with a button for what can be done about it (`ToastAction`: the button's `label` and what a press does, `run`), for eight seconds; a press takes the message away and does it; answers a function that takes the message away early, which does nothing once the message is gone or another is in its place. `rest(what, resting)`, for `Toast`: while the mouse (`pointer`) or the focus (`focus`) is on a message it stays, and its whole time again after; a message that takes the place of another keeps what rested on that one, the mouse and, if both have a button, the focus. Signals `message()` and `action()`: what is on screen.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `LinkCopier` (`link-copier.ts`) | Copies an address for the user to paste elsewhere and says so: `copy(address)` writes it to the clipboard, then shows the toast "Enlace copiado" (`Toaster`); when the browser refuses (no permission, not a secure page), nothing is copied and nothing is said, the address staying on screen. The management page's links (`EventLinks`, `apps/web/src/app/features/manage`), the private link on the voting page's thanks (`VoteThanks`, `apps/web/src/app/features/vote`) and the connector's address of "Apps conectadas" (`ConnectorAddress`, `apps/web/src/app/features/connected-apps`) are copied with it. |
| `STEP_CARD` (`step-stack.ts`)                                           | The card of the current step of a `StepStack`, as a CSS selector: what a step holds finds the card it is in with `closest`, as `screenRoom` does to keep a step's card on screen.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `HOLD_MS` (`long-press.ts`)                                             | How long the finger rests before a long press fires.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| `TOUCH_QUERY` (`screen-matches.ts`)                                     | The media query of a device with no mouse, `(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)`: nothing hovers, or the pointer is a finger. Read once by the wizard's steps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `screenRoom(host, parts, active)` (`screen-room.ts`)                    | The height, in pixels, that the boxes of a step may take for what ends the step (its buttons) to end above the bottom of the screen, 10 px free under it, with the page scrolled to its top and, in a `StepStack`, the steps above it folded into their tabs (`StepStack.rise`), as a signal: a card that comes in while the step before it still folds gets at once the room it keeps; `null` while `active()` is false or the parts are not on the page. `parts` are CSS selectors: `boxes`, inside `host`, which start at the same height, and `end`, what ends the step below them, inside `host` (its buttons) or around it (the step's card, `STEP_CARD`), and, if given, `aside`, boxes under the boxes whose height is left out of what goes below them (the tallest one's), for the page to show them only where the room spares them. Measured again after a render in which a signal read by `active` changed, when the window changes height and when the host, anything it is in or the page changes size, so also while a step folds above this one, which in a stack leaves the room as it was (where the browser has no `ResizeObserver`, not then). Called in an injection context; it stops listening with it. |
| `shapeOf(index, date, band, rows)`, `Shape`, `DayRows` (`day-shape.ts`) | How the day at `index` of a grid joins its neighbours in a band of days in a row from `band.start` to `band.end` (a range, an overlap, a painted choice): `joinsPrevious` / `joinsNext` when the neighbour is in the band and on the same row, `cutBefore` / `cutAfter` when the band goes on in another row or beyond the grid, `middle` when the day is neither its first nor its last. The grid's rows of seven start after its `leadingBlanks`; a band of one day joins nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `calendarWords(locale)`, `CalendarWords` (`calendar-words.ts`)          | The words of a month calendar in one language: `weekdays`, their initials from Monday on ("L", "M", "X"…); `monthTitle(month)`, a month (`YYYY-MM`) as a title with its year ("Julio 2026"); `dayName(date, today?)`, a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) named in full ("lunes, 6 de julio"); `dayOfMonth(date, today?)`, a date without its weekday ("6 de julio"), both with its year when given a `today` of another year ("viernes, 8 de enero de 2027"); `shortDay(date)`, a date as its short weekday, capitalised, and its day ("Lun 6"); `monthName(month)`, a month (`YYYY-MM`) in full, as a list shows it ("noviembre"); `weekday(date)`, its weekday in full ("sábado"). Dates are calendar values, read as UTC.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `CodeActions` (`code-step.ts`)                                          | What a `CodeStep` does with a complete code and how it asks for a new one: `use(code)` resolves once the code was right and its work is done (the page may be leaving) and rejects with the API's error otherwise, a `400` whose body is a wrong, expired or void code being a refusal of the code; `send()` sends a new code, replacing the last one, and resolves with the seconds until another may be asked.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

**Depends on:** `apps/web/src/styles`, `apps/web/src/app/core/api`, `apps/web/src/app/core/i18n`, `packages/contracts`, `packages/domain/src`.

### `apps/web/src/styles`

**Summary:** Design tokens, base styles and their checks.

**Purpose:** The colours, type, spacing, motion and breakpoints of the app (`docs/design-tokens.md`), and the tests that keep stylesheets on them: text contrast meets WCAG, and component stylesheets use tokens instead of literal values.

**Contents:** `_tokens.scss` (the design tokens), `_base.scss` (element defaults, among them `data-strong-text`, which shows the bold parts of the catalogue's markup set with `[innerHTML]` in the text colour, since no component's styles reach that markup; the typed text of every text field, in the interface typeface, semibold, `--q-text-typed`, and its focus ring only under `data-keyboard-focus`, set by `provideKeyboardFocusRing` in `apps/web/src/app/core/layout`), `_breakpoints.scss` (media query mixins), `_controls.scss` (the look of controls the pages' steps share: `line-icon-hover`, a bare line icon on the page background (the header's "Entrar" icon and account circle, the waves' play/pause button) a little lighter under the mouse where the device has one; `raised-hover`, how every raised button answers the mouse where the device has one, its raised shadow becoming a thin neutral ring as it sinks a little, its text colour kept unless the block given changes it (`@include raised-hover { … }`), not while disabled or `aria-disabled`, a background that changes with the button's own state eased too; every raised button includes it, so a new one has it from the start; `disclosure-toggle`, a button that opens and closes what follows it, its text with a chevron (the management page's section headings, `ManageSection`, `apps/web/src/app/features/manage`, and the names under a date of the results, `NameList`, `apps/web/src/app/features/results`): no shape of its own, the chevron turned up while open, a little paler under the mouse where the device has one, its size, gap and colours its own, included first so a font size given after it wins; `action-button`, a page's main action written out, a raised pill with bold text that greys out disabled ("Enviar código"); `small-action`, a small raised pill with bold text beside the line it acts on (the management page's "Copiar" and "Abrir", "Desconectar" in "Apps conectadas"), with `raised-hover`; `round-button`, the raised round arrow, whose arrow also darkens under the mouse, flat and grey while `aria-disabled`; `corner-control`, a small white circle with a sign in it on a corner of the positioned element it acts on, sized and placed with `--round`, `--from-bottom` and `--from-end`, never pressed on less than `$least-target` (24 px) and hidden until `corner-control-shown`; `count-pill`, a small white pill, sunk in, that says how far along something is, as the place among a step's pages "2 / 5" (`StepPager`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`) and the wizard's options counter, red and bold at its end with `count-pill-at-end`; `tool-button`, a button of a step's row of tools, an icon with 40 px to press and no shape of its own, red while pressed or under the mouse; `fold-arrow`, ︿ or ﹀ at an end of a list that scrolls a row at a time, as wide as its list and as tall as its `--fold-size`, grey with the class `spent`; `circle-link`, a round raised link with an icon alone, 60 px across (`NotFoundCard`'s house, the "+" of "Mis eventos"), its place the page's; `trash-button`, the app's one trash, a grey line icon with no shape of its own, red while pressed and, under the mouse, red and a little larger, its size and place the page's (`AskFirstButton`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`, and `AccountMenu`); `link-button`, a button that reads as a link in a step's text ("Reenviar código", "Cambiar email"), bold and underlined in the text's own type, plain grey text while disabled), `_answers.scss` (a dialog's answers side by side at the card's foot, "Volver" and the action, for `Dialog`'s question and for content that brings its own, as `AccountDeletion` in `apps/web/src/app/core/layout`; the consent page, `ConnectPage` in `apps/web/src/app/features/connect`, has them in its card, "Cancelar" and "Permitir"), `_question.scss` (what the questions in a dialog share: their title, one amber note per reason, the last line; the management page's and deleting the account), `_calendar.scss` (the look of the month calendar the pages' steps share: `card`, the white card around a month, which below 650 px reaches into the step card's padding; `month-title`, the month's name and year; `grid`, seven columns from Monday; `weekday`, a weekday's initial; `day-height`, for the component's `:host`, a day as tall as it is wide below 650 px and of a fixed height from there; `day-cell`, a day's number centred at that height; for the calendar where days are chosen, the wizard's dates, `header`, the row of the month's arrows and title, `month-arrow`, an arrow that changes the month, `picker-grid`, the grid with its rows further apart from 650 px, `weekdays-gap`, the weekdays as far from the days as a row from the next, `day-margin`, for the component's `:host`, a day's side margins, `day-place`, a day's place in the grid, and `day-button`, a day that can be chosen, a pill tinted under the mouse, pale and pressed by nothing when it cannot be chosen; `hold-ring`, for the `::after` of a positioned element a finger rests on (`LongPress`, `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`), a ring that fills around it until the long-press fires, with `hold-ring-motion` once in the same stylesheet, outside any rule), `_sign-in-texts.scss` (the texts of a card that asks one thing in the middle of the page, centred: its heading, the lead under it, a label, and the small lines that hint or say what went wrong; `_sign-in-step.scss` has them, and the consent page, `ConnectPage` in `apps/web/src/app/features/connect`, takes them alone, as its buttons are a dialog's answers), `_sign-in-step.scss` (the look the steps that ask for an email or a code share, the sign-in page's email step and `CodeStep` in `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`: the texts of `_sign-in-texts.scss`, the field, the button that sends and the buttons that read as links), `_state-card.scss` (`state-card`, the card of a state that stands for a whole page while the page has nothing else to show, its lines centred in a column, so that its words never fall on the drawing behind the page: `LoadingState`'s "Cargando…" and `ErrorState`'s "No se ha podido cargar", both in `apps/web/src/app/shared/ui`), `_wells.scss` (what the management page's lists of links and of emails share, `EventLinks` and `EventEmails` in `apps/web/src/app/features/manage`, and the connector's address of "Apps conectadas", `ConnectorAddress` in `apps/web/src/app/features/connected-apps`: a help line, then white wells, each with its name over a line and its actions beside them, `small-action`), `_list-card.scss` (the card of a page that lists the account's things, "Mis eventos" in `apps/web/src/app/features/my-events` and "Apps conectadas" in `apps/web/src/app/features/connected-apps`: its heading centred, then a row per thing between thin lines, each with its title over its state line, or a sentence where there is none); the test helpers below.

**Exports:**

| Export                                            | What it does                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contrastRatio(text, background)` (`contrast.ts`) | The WCAG contrast ratio (1–21) of a text colour, translucent or not, over an opaque background. |
| `parseColor(css)`, `Rgba` (`contrast.ts`)         | Reads a hex or `rgb()`/`rgba()` colour.                                                         |
| `readCustomProperties(css)` (`contrast.ts`)       | The custom properties of a stylesheet with their `var()` references resolved.                   |
| `literalValues(css)` (`token-usage.ts`)           | The colours, lengths and durations written by hand in a stylesheet, which should be tokens.     |

These helpers are used only by the tests; they never reach the app bundle.

**Depends on:** —

**Used by:** `apps/web/src`, `apps/web/src/app` (every component stylesheet).

### `apps/web/src/test`

**Summary:** Helpers for the web's own tests.

**Purpose:** What the browser has and jsdom does not, played by real objects the test controls. Left out of the app build and of mutation testing.

**Exports:**

| Export                                                                                                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `installTestScreen(matching)`, `TestScreen` (`media-queries.ts`)                                               | Replaces `window.matchMedia` with one that answers the given media queries (any other does not match); `set(query, matches)` changes an answer later and sends `change` to that query's lists, as when the screen turns wide.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `installTestRecognizer(name)`, `removeTestRecognizer()`, `TestRecognizer`, `TestRecognizers` (`recognizer.ts`) | The browser's speech recognizer, which jsdom has not: `installTestRecognizer` gives `window` one under its standard name (`SpeechRecognition`) or the prefixed one, and returns the list of the recognizers the page makes from then on; through each (`TestRecognizer`) the test sees how the page set it and left it (`lang`, `interimResults`, `continuous`, `state`) and has it say what the browser's would: `listens()`, `hears(...pieces)`, `fails(error)`, `ends()`. `removeTestRecognizer` leaves the browser without one. |

### `packages`

**Summary:** Code shared by the API and the web.

### `packages/contracts`

**Summary:** The API contract (`@qando/contracts`).

**Purpose:** Every endpoint defined once with its Zod schemas: the API reads requests and answers with them, the web uses their types and checks answers with them, and the OpenAPI document is generated from them. A test fails if the API does not serve an endpoint of the contract or answers outside its schemas.

**Contents:** `src/`; package, TypeScript, Vitest and Stryker settings.

**Depends on:** —

**Used by:** `apps/api`, `apps/web`.

### `packages/contracts/src`

**Summary:** Endpoints, Zod schemas and OpenAPI generation.

**Purpose:** The machinery every endpoint uses, the shared error bodies, the calendar values endpoints share, and the list of endpoints. `index.ts` re-exports everything the applications import.

**Contents:** `auth/`, `date-interpretations/`, `health/`, `management/`, `public-events/`, `results/`; the files below.

| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `urlOf(endpoint, params)` (`endpoint.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                              | The endpoint's path with each `{placeholder}` replaced, URL-encoded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `successBodyOf(endpoint, body)`, `errorResponseOf(endpoint, status, body)`, `isSuccessStatus(status)` (`endpoint.ts`)                                                                                                  | Checks a 2xx body against the success schemas (throws if it breaks them); finds the documented error answer of a status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `SuccessBody`, `ErrorResponse`, `ParamsOf`, `HeadersOf`, `RequestBodyOf` (`endpoint.ts`)                                                                                                                               | The types of an endpoint's answers and request parts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `errorBodySchema(code, shape)` (`error.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                            | The body every error shares: `{ error: { code, message, details } }`; `code` is what clients branch on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `internalErrorSchema`, `validationFailedSchema`, `fieldProblemSchema`, `unauthenticatedSchema`, `rateLimitedSchema`, `rateLimitedResponse`, `foreignPageSchema`, `ForeignPageBody`, `foreignPageResponse` (`error.ts`) | The shared error answers: `500`, `400` naming each broken part (never its value), `401` without any credential, `429`, and `403 FORBIDDEN` to a request only qando's pages may send (signing in, reading a date phrase) from a page of another site, or without `Origin`, session or not.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `InternalErrorBody`, `ValidationFailedBody`, `FieldProblem`, `RateLimitedBody` (`error.ts`)                                                                                                                            | The types of those bodies.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `calendarDate`, `clockTime`, `timeZoneName` (`calendar-values.ts`)                                                                                                                                                     | The schemas of a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and of a wall-clock time (`HH:MM`, 00:00 to 23:59), both with no zone: the schema that carries one says where it is read; and of an IANA time zone the runtime knows, never an offset such as `-02:00` (the runtime takes it, PostgreSQL reads it with the opposite sign). Used inside the contract (`packages/contracts/src/public-events`, `packages/contracts/src/date-interpretations`, `packages/contracts/src/management`); `index.ts` does not re-export them. |
| `endpoints` (`endpoints.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                                           | Every endpoint the API serves; the OpenAPI document lists exactly these.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `createOpenApiDocument()` (`openapi.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                               | Builds the OpenAPI document from the endpoints' schemas.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
